name: Ever Sunshine Services Group Limited
summary: Ever Sunshine Services Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides property management services in the People's Republic of China. The company offers services for residential and non-residential properties, such as office buildings, shopping malls, school campus, hospitals, scenic spots, government-owned buildings, expressway stations, rail transit, and ferry terminals. It also provides value added services to non-property owners, including sales assistance, additional tailored services, housing repair, pre-delivery inspection, and preliminary planning and design consultancy services.
